literal: Disgrace if comes who do not live, honor those who possess - glory having bowed will praise the world.
translation: The world will bow down and praise the glory of honorable people who will not survive if disgrace befalls them.
modern: தமக்கு ஒரு சிறுமை வந்தால் உயிரோடு வாழாத மானம் உடையவர்களின் புகழை, இந்த உலகம் தொழுது போற்றும்.
explanation: This couplet describes the ultimate standard of personal dignity. The word 'இளி' means disgrace or indignity, representing anything that compromises one's self-respect. The word 'ஒளி' literally means light, but in this context, it is best understood as the radiant glory or lasting fame of the honorable. The text states that those who possess true dignity will not continue to live if they face such disgrace. Because of this unwavering commitment to their honor, the world will bow down and praise their brilliant legacy.
